added: packages/api-contracts (@sos-2/api-contracts): the typed API boundary — PURE TYPES + GUARDS with ZERO runtime dependencies (imports nothing). The single shared home of the P2 boundary vocabulary: the six typed error envelopes (UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, CONFLICT/stale-revision, DUPLICATE/replayed, NOT_FOUND, INVALID) with guards and a single builder; record write outcomes (STORED | IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY); the typed RevisionConflictRecord (STALE_REVISION / REVISION_DIVERGENCE carrying the CURRENT stored revision); pagination cursors (opaque base64url codec, clamped limits); revision headers (x-sos-revision, x-sos-record-id, x-sos-write-outcome, x-sos-total-count); observation event ingestion payloads (EventIngestionRequest — every event carries an event_id for replay protection — plus the stored ObservationEventRecord, the typed DuplicateEventRecord and EventDivergenceRecord); provider-health payloads (typed UP/UNCONFIGURED/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN availability, the NEVER-CANONICAL flag, typed coordination-degradation records and ProviderAvailabilityRecord for typed UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN failures). Domain record payloads cross this boundary as validated JSON preserved verbatim — the semantic types and guards remain owned by the frozen domain packages; this package defines no second semantic registry (AGENTS.md section 4)

packages/live-store (@sos-2/live-store): durable, provider-neutral repositories for the live product state. SEMANTIC DISCIPLINE (each pinned by tests): (1) semantic ids and exact revisions are preserved VERBATIM — records are validated by the OWNING frozen domain packages' guards consumed verbatim (assertValidMission, assertValidContext, assertValidSystemStateArtifact, assertValidEvidenceRecord, assertValidArchitectureGraphArtifact, assertValidCandidateState, assertValidAssuranceCase, assertValidExperiment, assertValidDecisionRecord, assertValidGrant, assertValidPackageArtifact, assertValidArchitectureMemory, assertValidCausalHypothesis, assertValidProvenanceRecord), ids are EXTRACTED (spine-minted envelope ids / content-addressed record ids / P2-owned state ids), never re-minted, and content is never rewritten (store->load round-trip equality on canonical serialization consumed from @sos-2/semantic-spine); (2) idempotent writes — replaying an identical write is a NO-OP returning the stored record (not an error, not a duplicate, no second durable write); (3) stale-revision detection — a write whose revision is OLDER than the stored revision fails with a typed STALE_REVISION conflict record carrying the current revision (optimistic concurrency); an equal-revision divergent write fails with a typed REVISION_DIVERGENCE conflict; a forward write is stored; (4) the sanctioned spine lifecycle transition flows through the DEDICATED setStatus operation (spine withStatus — identity preserved, invalid transitions rejected loudly), the W12 RepositoryAdapter precedent — raw same-revision divergent puts conflict; (5) durable task/checkpoint records realizing the EXACT section 6 task-durability shape of spec/productization-execution-architecture.md (task identity + mission link, plan/work graph, owned revision, authority context, body lease ref, checkpoints, artifacts, evidence refs, unresolved uncertainty, retries/recovery state, cost consumption, final verification record) plus BodyLeaseRecord and DevelopmentStateRecord (machine-state snapshots stored verbatim, read-only authority discipline); (6) event ingestion with replay protection — the durable event log is keyed by event_id; duplicate delivery is detected and skipped with a typed DUPLICATE record (never double-applied), divergent redelivery is a typed EVENT_DIVERGENCE conflict, and dedup correctness NEVER depends on the coordination layer; (7) REDIS IS NEVER CANONICAL — the coordination port is used best-effort (verified read-through cache with eviction+repair, idempotency keys, lease heartbeats); flushing or removing it entirely leaves semantic state intact and queryable from the durable store (pinned by tests), and coordination failures never fail semantics but are recorded as typed CoordinationDegradationRecords (never silent); (8) the explicit typed failure model — provider failures surface ProviderUnavailableError (the operation was NOT performed) / ProviderUnknownError (outcome cannot be determined), both carrying typed availability records; success is never fabricated and failure is never silent

packages/live-store provider PORTS (Neon/Upstash/R2 targets, vendor SDKs NOT added in this Work Order): PostgresStoreAdapter (durable semantic state — THE canonical home, Neon target; canonical-serialized row payloads + exact row revisions), RedisCoordinationAdapter (coordination ONLY — cache/idempotency/leases; role documents the NEVER-CANONICAL rule; flushAll() exists so the rule is testable), ObjectStoreAdapter (Cloudflare R2 target — large immutable artifacts by content hash; content addressing enforced, re-put identical bytes is an idempotent no-op, different bytes under an existing hash is a typed integrity violation). Complete in-memory reference implementations of all three (injected clocks, deterministic ordering); domain packages never import provider specifics — real Neon/Upstash/R2 adapters attach later without contract change

apps/api (@sos-2/api): the API service — a plain Node + TypeScript (node:http, repo-standard ESM + tsc build, ZERO vendor framework) implementation of api-contracts over the live-store ports. Route surface: GET /api/health (per-provider typed availability — reference providers report UP; UNCONFIGURED production targets report typed UNKNOWN/UNCONFIGURED, never fabricated UP; a failing attached provider reports typed UNAVAILABLE and degrades the service status); GET/PUT /api/{mission,system-state,evidence,task,body-lease} (reads+writes with revision headers, opaque cursor pagination, idempotent replays, typed 409 conflicts carrying the current revision, 400 INVALID with the owning guard messages); GET/POST /api/observation/events (event ingestion with replay protection — 409 DUPLICATE for replayed deliveries, 409 EVENT_DIVERGENCE for divergent redelivery) and GET /api/observation/events?event_id=. The ROUTER is a pure request/response function — framework-independent, hostable later in Vercel functions or an external worker boundary WITHOUT contract change; NO long-running work inside request lifetimes (every handler is exactly one bounded store operation); provider outages answer typed 503 UNAVAILABLE / 500 UNKNOWN envelopes (never fabricated success); all clocks/stores/ports are INJECTED (the CLI entry main.ts is the single composition root consulting the real clock and API_PORT)
preserved_invariants: the frozen W0-W18 core is untouched: spec/, docs/ (outside this evidence path), scripts/, .github/ and every existing packages/* and apps/* source are unmodified — all changes are additive under the owned paths packages/live-store, packages/api-contracts and apps/api (the P2 owned-path contract); pnpm-workspace.yaml is untouched (packages/* and apps/* were already workspace globs) and the lockfile is unchanged (no committed lockfile exists; zero new external dependencies — workspace:* packages plus the repository's existing toolchain only)

the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity authority (AGENTS.md section 4): the live store EXTRACTS the ids records already carry (spine-minted envelope ids, content-addressed Evidence/ProvenanceRecord ids) and never mints, rewrites or re-derives any sos:// identity; canonical serialization and content hashing are CONSUMED from @sos-2/semantic-spine, never reimplemented; P2-owned state identities (task ids, lease ids, event ids) are plain caller-supplied productization-layer strings, and the only sos:// references they carry (mission_ref, grant refs, evidence refs) are validated as well-formed spine ids — no second semantic registry is introduced

domain record shapes are STORED and RETURNED VERBATIM: every repository validates through the owning frozen package's guard consumed verbatim and returns the record it was given (bit-exact canonical round trips); truth states and provenance are preserved bit-exact — UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN (never UNAVAILABLE), LLM-marked evidence stays llm_output: true (never authoritative), exact source/deployment revisions are preserved (never defaulted)

Redis is NEVER canonical (spec/productization-requirements.md): the coordination port serves cache/idempotency/leases ONLY, its health always reports canonical: false, it is optional (the store runs correctly with coordination: null), flushing it never loses or changes semantic state, and its failures degrade coordination (typed records) without ever failing or fabricating semantics — pinned by the flush test, the no-coordination test and the failing-coordination test

the failure model stays truthful (spec/productization-execution-architecture.md section 13): provider outages and unconfigured providers surface as typed UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN availability records — never fabricated success, never silent absence-of-failure; unknown and unavailable remain DISTINCT; the durable store (PostgresStoreAdapter role) is the single canonical semantic substrate and task/checkpoint state survives facade recreation (a body crash, provider outage or process loss never erases a task)

LLM output is never authoritative (spec/architecture.md section 18): stored evidence records preserve the W3 llm_output mark and producer provenance verbatim; the store never strips, forges or upgrades authority marks (validation runs through the owning guards)

event ingestion is replay-safe (spec/productization-work-orders/P7 inputs, realized at the boundary): every event carries an id; duplicate delivery is detected and skipped with a typed DUPLICATE record — never double-applied — and divergent redelivery is a typed conflict, never a silent overwrite; dedup correctness derives from the durable log, never from Redis

boundary_changes: three new workspace packages, one-directional and acyclic, consumed by NOTHING at this base: @sos-2/api-contracts (zero runtime dependencies) <- @sos-2/live-store (runtime deps: @sos-2/api-contracts + the frozen domain packages mission, context, system-state, evidence, architecture, assurance, experiments, decision, authority, packages, memory, causal, provenance, semantic-spine) <- apps/api (runtime deps: @sos-2/api-contracts + @sos-2/live-store; test-only devDependencies on @sos-2/mission/@sos-2/system-state/@sos-2/evidence exist solely to mint VALID domain records for contract fixtures)

@sos-2/live-store is the CONSUMER of the frozen domain packages — it stores and returns their record shapes verbatim and never redefines them (the AGENTS.md section 4 boundary holds); the domain packages import nothing new (provider specifics live only in live-store's provider-ports/in-memory-providers modules)

@sos-2/api-contracts is the shared BOUNDARY vocabulary home for P2-owned wire/storage shapes (typed error envelopes, outcomes, conflict/duplicate/divergence records, event payloads, health payloads) — deliberately NOT a second semantic registry: it registers no identities, kinds or trace types and defines no domain record shapes (domain payloads cross as validated JSON, guarded by the owning packages inside @sos-2/live-store)

the provider ports (PostgresStoreAdapter -> Neon, RedisCoordinationAdapter -> Upstash, ObjectStoreAdapter -> Cloudflare R2) are designed so later waves attach real vendor adapters WITHOUT contract change (vendor SDKs are NOT added in this Work Order; the in-memory reference implementations carry the full semantic contract); apps/api's pure router keeps the same service contract hostable in Vercel functions or an external worker boundary without change (per docs/deployment/free-tier-plan.md provider roles and the Vercel no-long-running-work rule)
